correctness.rationale: For distinct three sites, the Fourier spectral positivity and Vandermonde argument establish positive-definite covariance. Inverting its 3x3 Toeplitz Gram matrix gives Q13=(H_t(a)^2-H_t(0)H_t(2a))/det. For q=e^{-t} and r=q^(2j-1), each theta-product factor obeys B_r(c)^2-A_r C_r(c)=4r(1-c)(c(1+r+r²)+r); at c=0 all are positive, at c=-1/3 all negative. The log derivative 4r/B_r-8rc/C_r is strictly positive for c in [-1/3,0], and geometric decay permits termwise differentiation. For c outside this interval the factor signs preclude another zero. The periodic Gaussian Poisson formula yields 4t log R -> -2a²+4(pi-a)², root pi(2-sqrt 2), and the first product factor yields c_t=-exp(-t)+O(exp(-2t)). Independently evaluated theta matrices at t=.03,.3,1,4,10 and checked factor identity and sign/root; that is only corroboration.
residual_risks: Only symmetric triples, exact circle length 2pi, t>0, a in (0,pi); no monotonicity of a_*(t) in t and no higher-site conclusion.
